items.title: Activity-only sound can be saved and cleared
items.precondition: Signed-in user on Account Settings with message sound set to None.
steps: Choose an activity tone and save
Choose No activity sound and save
items.expected: The activity-only choice persists without a message tone; clearing it persists silence.
items.evidence: Static contract verified by typecheck: nullable activitySoundId is persisted or removed; save has no message-id gate.
items.notes: Requires browser interaction to verify localStorage/UI persistence.

items.title: Message and activity tones do not interrupt each other
items.precondition: Signed-in user has selected both a message and activity tone and completed the browser audio unlock gesture.
steps: Trigger or observe close-together message and activity notifications
items.expected: One domain’s playback does not pause/reset the other domain’s audio element.
items.evidence: Static contract verified: SoundRuntime has distinct messageAudio and activityAudio; playback stops only its own kind.

items.title: Badge count follows read and friend-request mutations
items.precondition: Two signed-in users; recipient has one unread activity notification and one pending friend request; sockets connected.
steps: Open Notifications to mark activity items read
Accept or decline the pending request
Create and cancel another pending request
items.expected: The recipient badge receives the refreshed count after each count-changing action without a route change.
items.evidence: Static contract verified: NotificationService emits after changed reads; FriendshipService emits after accept, decline, and cancel.

items.title: Open notifications list refreshes on a count event
items.precondition: Recipient is on /notifications with a connected socket; second user can create an activity notification.
steps: Create a comment/reply notification for the recipient
items.expected: The new notification appears in the open list and then is marked read; no repeated refresh loop occurs.
items.evidence: Static contract verified: NotificationsPage subscribes to notifications:count; NotificationService emits after reads only if rows changed.
items.notes: Requires a running isolated browser acceptance environment.

items.title: Typecheck, build, and lint
items.precondition: Lockfile dependencies installed in the isolated worktree.
items.expected: Commands pass with no errors caused by this execution.
items.notes: Existing lint warnings are baseline warnings outside this plan. This branch does not define the Constitution checker script, so its strict check is unavailable here.
